reading_rule: Gate 0 is the battery's own control: every attack must SUCCEED ungated before its gated refusal counts for anything. A route whose gate0 is false proves nothing, however the gated arm behaves.

routes.name: Forged band — payload claims a higher-trust provenance
routes.ungated: ungated: elevation granted on the payload's own claim
routes.gated_reason: band is 'tool', elevation requires 'session'; the band was stamped from the arrival channel and the payload's own claim was never read
routes.x_note: the claim never reaches the band derivation — _band_for_channel does not take the payload as a parameter

routes.name: Forged capability — a fabricated tag presented directly
routes.ungated: ungated: elevation granted on the payload's own claim
routes.gated_reason: MAC verification failed: tag is not the one governance would have computed for these fields under this epoch key
routes.x_stateless_refusal: [B] MAC verification failed: tag is not the one governance would have computed for these fields under this epoch key
routes.x_with_issued_set_refusal: [B] MAC verification failed: tag is not the one governance would have computed for these fields under this epoch key
routes.x_note: stateless is the honest test of the MAC; the set catches it too and does so without relying on A1 at all

routes.name: Retired-epoch replay — a genuine capability from a previous epoch
routes.ungated: ungated: elevation granted on the payload's own claim
routes.gated_reason: retired epoch: capability minted in epoch 0, governance is at epoch 1 (integer comparison; no MAC property used)
routes.x_same_forgery_after_rotation: allowed=False [F] retired epoch: capability minted in epoch 0, governance is at epoch 1 (integer comparison; no MAC property used)
routes.x_note: a leaked epoch key mints freely WHILE its epoch is current — that is what a leak means — and every capability it ever produces dies at rotation by integer comparison, no MAC property used

routes.name: Tier escalation — a low-tier capability presented for a high-tier action
routes.ungated: ungated: elevation granted on the payload's own claim
routes.gated_reason: tier mismatch: capability grants tier 0, action requires tier 2

routes.name: Budget exhaustion — minting past gov_budget without rotating
routes.ungated: ungated: minted 5 with no budget at all
routes.gated_reason: mint budget exhausted: 3/3 in epoch 0; rotate to mint again
routes.x_refusal: [budget] mint budget exhausted: 3/3 in epoch 0; rotate to mint again
routes.x_note: the epoch bounds damage by MINT COUNT, not elapsed time — gov_budget is the operator's most consequential choice

routes.name: Replay within an epoch — BADGE SEMANTICS, bounded by rotation
routes.property: a capability may be presented repeatedly within its epoch, and is dead after rotation
routes.ungated: ungated: elevation granted on the payload's own claim
routes.gated_reason: retired epoch: capability minted in epoch 0, governance is at epoch 1 (integer comparison; no MAC property used)
routes.x_property: a capability may be presented repeatedly within its epoch, and is dead after rotation
routes.x_after_rotation: allowed=False [F] retired epoch: capability minted in epoch 0, governance is at epoch 1
routes.x_note: BY DESIGN, not a gap. A capability is a BADGE: valid for its epoch, presentable repeatedly. Specified as D-BADGE in th_model.rs and proved by thm_badge_presentation_does_not_consume and thm_badge_bounded_by_rotation. The bound is rotation, at conjunct (F), by integer comparison. ACCEPTED EXPOSURE: an adversary who can observe a capability can present it until rotation -- which is why gov_budget and rotation cadence matter.

routes.name: Forged channel — connect to a LOW-trust listener, claim high trust
routes.ungated: ungated: connected to TOOL listener, claimed band in payload, system reported 'session'
routes.gated_reason: band is 'tool', elevation requires 'session'; the band was stamped from the arrival channel and the payload's own claim was never read
routes.x_note: The payload claimed band=session and via=GOVERNANCE on every connection. Each listener reported its OWN band. The claim is not refused -- it is never read.

routes.name: Reaching the governance listener directly — HONEST FAILURE
routes.property: each listener yields ITS OWN band — reaching the governance socket IS presenting as governance
routes.ungated: ungated: reaching the socket yields band 'governance'
routes.x_property: each listener yields ITS OWN band — reaching the governance socket IS presenting as governance
routes.x_note: BY DESIGN AND NOT CLOSED HERE. Reaching the governance socket IS presenting as governance -- the band is the socket. Restricting reach is a NETWORK property (firewall, bind address, socket permissions); this code neither performs nor proves it. The 0600 mode above is a gesture, not the restriction. Reported as a property, not a defeat.
